title: Planck joked Planck length would be best way to communicate with aliens
summary: David Grusch tells of Planck joked Planck length would be best way to communicate with aliens, about early 20th century at Germany, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and you know, Planck literally after discovering the Planck length thought that that would be the best way to communicate with aliens because it's that literally the shortest length.

plain: David Grusch, a witness in the debate over government UFO secrets, said on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that the German physicist Max Planck had an idea about aliens. According to Grusch, after Planck worked out the Planck length, the shortest length that makes sense in physics, he thought it would be the best way to communicate with aliens, since it is a measure any advanced mind would share. Grusch tells it to suggest that physics itself might be a common language with other intelligences.
